name: Hou MCP Workflow Pack
description: View and browse WorkflowPack definitions from the registry. Returns the full pack configuration including all strategies. Supports: industrial_hangar_pack, robotics_lab_pack, control_room_pack, sci_fi_corridor_pack, abandoned_factory_pack.
python_code:
import json

async def execute(self, inputs):
    from src.runtime.workflows import get_workflow_registry

    pack_name   = str(inputs.get('pack_name') or self.parameters.get('pack_name', 'industrial_hangar_pack') or '')
    list_all    = bool(inputs.get('list_all') or self.parameters.get('list_all', False))
    environment = str(inputs.get('environment') or self.parameters.get('environment', '') or '')

    try:
        registry = get_workflow_registry()

        if list_all:
            packs = registry.list_packs(environment_type=environment or None)
            pack_list = [{'name': p.name, 'environment': p.environment_type,
                          'version': p.version,
                          'tags': p.metadata.get('tags', [])} for p in packs]
            self.log_info(f'[WorkflowPack] {len(packs)} packs registered')
            return {
                'pack_json':       json.dumps(pack_list[0].get('name', '') if pack_list else ''),
                'pack_name_out':   pack_list[0].get('name', '') if pack_list else '',
                'environment_type': pack_list[0].get('environment', '') if pack_list else '',
                'pack_count':      len(packs),
                'pack_list_json':  json.dumps(pack_list, sort_keys=True),
                'ok':              True,
                'exec_out':        True,
            }

        pack = registry.get_pack(pack_name)
        if not pack:
            self.log_error(f'[WorkflowPack] Pack not found: {pack_name!r}')
            return {
                'pack_json': json.dumps({'error': f'Pack not found: {pack_name}'}),
                'pack_name_out': pack_name,
                'environment_type': '',
                'pack_count': registry.get_statistics().get('total_packs', 0),
                'pack_list_json': '[]',
                'ok': False,
                'exec_out': True,
            }

        self.log_info(f'[WorkflowPack] Retrieved: {pack.name!r} ({pack.environment_type})')
        return {
            'pack_json':        json.dumps(pack.to_dict(), sort_keys=True),
            'pack_name_out':    pack.name,
            'environment_type': pack.environment_type,
            'pack_count':       registry.get_statistics().get('total_packs', 0),
            'pack_list_json':   '[]',
            'ok':               True,
            'exec_out':         True,
        }
    except Exception as e:
        self.log_error(f'[WorkflowPack] {e}')
        return {
            'pack_json': json.dumps({'error': str(e)}),
            'pack_name_out': pack_name,
            'environment_type': '',
            'pack_count': 0,
            'pack_list_json': '[]',
            'ok': False,
            'exec_out': True,
        }

def register_node():
    from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
    class Hou_Mcp_Workflow_Pack(BaseNode):
        name = 'hou_mcp_workflow_pack'
        async def execute(self, inputs):
            return await execute(self, inputs)
    return Hou_Mcp_Workflow_Pack
